summary: Leon County (not Okaloosa) park. The county's pages no longer show a campground here: the park index lists Williams Landing with boat ramp, grill, picnic area, restroom and water fountain only, the WebTrac home lists campgrounds at Coe Landing and Hall Landing only, and a Williams Landing campsite search returns no sites (Coe Landing returns 20 for the same date). Nothing written; fields and note left for a human to decide.
flags: Possible closure / no longer a campground: Leon County's Park Index (https://cms.leoncountyfl.gov/Government/Departments/Resource-Stewardship/Parks-Recreation/Park-Index) gives Williams Landing's amenities as 'Boat Ramp, Grill, Picnic Area, Restroom, Water Fountain' with no 'Campground' (Coe Landing and Luther Hall Landing list 'Campground'); the reservations site (https://reservations.leoncountyfl.gov/) lists Campgrounds: 'Coe Landing', 'Hall Landing' only; and the WebTrac campsite search for Primarycode=Williams Landing returns 'Your search did not return any matching results' for 2026-10-21 and 2027-03-10, while the same search for Coe Landing returns 20 sites at $27. The campsite page still carries a 'Williams Landing Map' link and says 'Coe and Williams Landing have an additional bed tax of 5%', so the camping may have been removed recently or be closed. The derived booking (reservable online) and the note's '10 water-only sites ... Reservable online via Leon County's portal' are unconfirmed. Phone 850-606-1470 (county Parks office) matches.

Stale website: https://reservations.leoncountyfl.gov/ is the county's whole reservation portal, which no longer offers this campground; Leon County's park listing is https://cms.leoncountyfl.gov/Government/Departments/Resource-Stewardship/Parks-Recreation/Park-Index.
